reviews.text: We’ve always wanted a covered patio and Kenny and Deck Masters delivered in spades! We highly recommend him and his team because: Kenny had great designs that sparked our excitement, he did ALL the work - pristinely- to satisfy our HOA, had connections for concrete, roofing and the staining done after completion, his team was very quick, friendly and impressively organized. And all for a very fair price. We are so happy, thank you Deck Masters!
reviews.author: April Hull

reviews.text: We had Kenny and the team at Deck Masters build a pergola and then had it stained by a stainer who works with Kenny. We also had an electrician move a patio ceiling outlet and do some related work, due to the pergola. The electrician also has worked with Kenny on decks and pergola projects. We are very happy with the end results. We got just what we wanted. We also plan to work with the stainer and electrician on some other projects. We recommend Kenny and Deck Masters to anyone who might be considering a pergola or arbor.
reviews.author: PJCorbett Scanner

reviews.text: The team at Deck Masters did an amazing job and the final product was perfect. We had a vision and they were able to walk us through every step and connect us with professionals for every phase from prepping the HOA to staining and concrete. They went above and beyond to make sure we were happy with everything in a timely manner. We can’t recommend them enough to anyone that needs a patio placed! We love our space outside!
reviews.author: Tanya Linsley

reviews.text:
Kenny @ Deckmasters AND his guys, were great. The crews knew exactly what & how to give us an excellent covered patio.
A flawless experience- done on time - and on budget…
All question's I had during the build, were addressed professionally and immediately…
Appreciate the end results Kenny..!
reviews.author: Clayton Ferguson

reviews.text: Kenny and his team were fantastic to work with. My previous home had the same patio layout and I was told that it would not be possible to cover it. Purchased this home with same layout, found Kenny with Deck Masters and he delivered!! I am absolutely in love with my new patio cover. Highly recommended Kenny Rose and his crew.
reviews.author: Missy Tavares

reviews.text: 5 STAR COMPANY!  Kenny worked with our pool builder ahead of time for proper placement of piers and color matched our roof for a seamless transition.  We've had this pool/patio for 5 years now and it looks as good today as the day it was built!  They source their own lumber from Washington and there are not huge cracks in beams/posts that I frequently see on other patios.  On top of everything else, they built our patio quickly and cleaned up like it was their own property.  I can not speak more highly of this well run company.
reviews.author: Shane Shepherd

reviews.text: We worked with Kenny Rose from Deck Masters for the additional extension of our patio and could not ask for a better experience. He is very knowledgeable about what he does and comes up with great solutions on the spot. On top of books of pictures of prior work he also draws the idea for your patio so you have a good visual right there during the quote visit. He has a great and experienced crew.  He recommends and works closely with other contractors for a quote and seamless finished results so by his recommendation we worked with Superior Concrete & Pavers, LLC (S-CAP) for concrete work. You can choose your own contractor if you prefer.
reviews.author: Anna J

reviews.text: Kenny was a joy to deal with. They built our patio cover exactly how I wanted it. Great quality with very impressive results! I would highly recommend Deck Master's!
reviews.author: Shane Baxter
